test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In an examination hall seven students Ayaan, Chandan, Jatin, Kanika, Naina, Pinky, and Sweety are sitting in a row facing North but not necessarily in the same order. Chandan sits third to the right of Sweety. Ayaan and Pinky are immediate neighbours of Chandan. More than two persons sit between Pinky and Sweety. Jatin is the only neighbour of Naina. Jatin sits to the right of Ayaan. What is the position of Naina with respect to Kanika?
solution:
**Given :** In an examination hall seven students Ayaan, Chandan, Jatin, Kanika, Naina, Pinky, and Sweety are sitting in a row facing North

**Explanation :**

1) Chandan sits third to the right of Sweety

2) Ayaan and Pinky are immediate neighbours of Chandan.

3) More than two persons sit between Pinky and Sweety.

As definite position of Sweety is not given, therefore there are three possible cases for the position of Sweety.

 
• Case - (1)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a0ceb16f598b6cf6d0a1e2919d40aa1fd535c40f0e1fd4edbfbe4a4a75f3a1aa.png] 

 
• Case - (2)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb408a2702f3b595cee7d992e256d23d57e1bf0d8dda185c7877eadc74bba34c.png] 

 
• Case - (3)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e324307ce13e98a3d2d9d05f5684f566bf14398d6e125e2cf94f02e6a966b075.png] 

4) Jatin is the only neighbour of Naina.

5) Jatin sits to the right of Ayaan.

There is no possible position for Naina in case - (2), thus is eliminated.

There is no possible position for Ayaan in case - (3), thus is eliminated.

As Jatin is the only neighbour of Naina, Naina will sit at right end.

 
• Case - (1)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e068bb702fce0845a19ec0cc3b537a34312879726040304ef548d58c4216774.png] 

As, in the options only fifth to the right is given therefore, **Naina sits fifth to the right of kanika.** 

So, Final arrangement will be as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e068bb702fce0845a19ec0cc3b537a34312879726040304ef548d58c4216774.png] 

Hence, **"Fifth to the right"** is the correct answer.
